title: Flatten Multi-File Crates And Packages Into Single lib.rs Index.ts Entries
description: Repo-wide sweep to flatten multi-file Rust crates and JS/TS packages down to a single entry file (lib.rs, index.ts/index.tsx), following up on the earlier script.ts consolidation ticket. Scan found 17 multi-file Rust crates (31 extra .rs files, e.g. fsm/rs with 7, puzzle/plugin/rs and cad/plugin/rs and fsm/macros/rs with 4 each) and 47 multi-file TS/TSX packages (190 extra files, largest being mathematical/graph/manifest at 17, framework/renderer/react at 16, repo/server/coordinator at 15). Merge sibling/submodule files into each crate's lib.rs (using inline `mod foo { ... }` blocks to preserve module boundaries/privacy) or package's index.ts/index.tsx (using `#region`/`#endregion` comment blocks), deleting the merged-in files and fixing all internal relative imports plus any external importers that reference the old sub-file paths directly. Explicitly SKIP and document rationale for structurally-required splits: compose/client/ui/desktop and coda/client/ui/desktop (Electron apps, main/preload/renderer run in separate JS processes/contexts), compose/client/ui/vscode (extension host vs webview run in separate contexts), mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage (routed web app, files likely map to routes), framework/product/os/dev/renderer-modules/wgpu/asset (contains generated codegen output under generated/, mixed concern), repo/client/vscode/.vscode-test/* and .repo/cache/vcpkg/* (vendored/downloaded, not our source). Verify each merged crate with cargo check and each merged package by grepping for stale import paths plus a build/typecheck where feasible.
summary:
Flattened 11 multi-file Rust crates to a single lib.rs (mechanical `mod foo;` → inline `mod foo { ... }` collapse, module paths unchanged so zero downstream `use` fixups): fsm/rs (6 files), puzzle/plugin/rs (3, including in-progress uncommitted d3/mod.rs preserved exactly), fsm/macros/rs (3), cad/plugin/rs (3), trinity/plugin/rs (2, including in-progress uncommitted app_jack.rs/app_rewrite.rs preserved exactly), procedural/plugin/rs (2), reasoning/mindmap/plugin/rs (1), process/plugin/rs (1), gis/plugin/rs (1), framework/plugin/rs (1), and lowpoly/core/rs (1 Cargo integration-test file folded into an inline `#[cfg(test)]` module). Also fixed a real design smell surfaced along the way: lowpoly's integration test used a `#[path = "../../../../cad/plugin/rs/geometry_import.rs"]` hack to bypass crate boundaries and re-parse a private module from a different crate as its own translation unit; since that file no longer exists after the cad/plugin/rs merge, replaced the hack at the root — made `geometry_import` `pub mod` in cad/plugin/rs, added `cad-plugin` as a proper `[dev-dependencies]` entry in lowpoly/core/rs/Cargo.toml, and updated the test to a normal `use cad_plugin::geometry_import::...` import.

Flattened 2 multi-file TS packages to a single index.ts, inlining the smaller file's content as a `#[region]`-style block: framework/renderer/wgpu (js/index.ts inlined into root index.ts; js/boot.ts kept separate — it's a Trunk/HTML `<script>`-loaded page entry, not part of the library's module graph) and ui/styling/js (theme.ts inlined into index.ts).

Verified: `cargo check --workspace` passes clean; `cargo test -p lowpoly_core export_concrete_forest_left_lowpoly_mesh_json` passes; `cargo check -p cad-plugin` passes after the `pub mod` change; both TS packages' actual vitest suites (`bun ./script.ts test`) pass (ui/styling/js: 11/12 pass, the 1 failure is in an untouched file — vite-elements-assets.ts, fixture/GLB-dependent, pre-existing and unrelated; framework/renderer/wgpu: 2/2 pass).

Scope correction from the original ticket: the initial file-count scan (190 "extra" TS files across 47 packages) turned out to be dominated by false positives — tool-mandated config files (eslint/postcss/tailwind/vite/vitest/next.config.*, forge.config.ts, playwright.config.ts), Next.js App Router files (route.ts/layout.tsx/page.tsx, filesystem-routed), codegen output (generated/, *.generated.ts), Web Worker scripts (*.worker.ts, separate execution context), and Vite HTML entry points beyond the package's main export. After excluding those, the real remaining candidates were only the 2 TS packages merged above. Explicitly skipped and left as-is with rationale: compose/client/ui/desktop and coda/client/ui/desktop (Electron main/preload/renderer, separate processes), compose/client/ui/vscode (extension host vs webview, separate contexts), mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage (routed slide app), repo/server/coordinator (Next.js App Router), compose/client/lib/js and kernel/3d/brep/js (Worker scripts), compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js's boot.tsx (separate Vite HTML entry). On the Rust side: framework/renderer/wgpu/rs (bin.rs + build.rs, both Cargo-mandated separate compilation targets), puzzle/2d/rs, mathematical/graph/manifest/rs, infinite/cavas/rs, gis/2d/rs (build.rs, Cargo build scripts), ui/styling/rs (generated.rs, actively regenerated codegen output). Also deliberately left framework/renderer/react untouched despite having 14 mergeable files — it's under active concurrent edit by another session (Window Tool Panel ticket), too risky to touch mid-flight.
